content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka
content_sections.text: NRLM Karnataka runs rural livelihood programmes in Karnataka and recruits through the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal. This post serves the Mission's Farm Livelihoods work in Mandya district. That work includes block and cluster farm teams, community resource persons (CRPs), organic farming practices and links between farmers and buyers.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the District Manager - Farm Livelihood
content_sections.text: Maintaining coordination with Block and Cluster level Farm Livelihoods Managers / Coordinators. Coordinating with other line departments for convergence at district level. Planning and monitoring all farm livelihoods related activities within the district. Submitting periodical reports as per the instructions of district and state authorities. Monitoring and supporting the activities of the farm livelihoods CRPs. Developing and executing capacity building plans on farm livelihoods for project staff and community members. Identifying and documenting best practices in farm livelihoods initiatives. Ensuring data collection and entry into MIS for monitoring and evaluation of farm livelihoods activities. Supporting the Farm Livelihoods teams in developing protocols and package of practices for organic farming, and facilitating the workshops and consultations needed for this. Identifying institutional and local buyers and conducting buyer-seller meets. Any other tasks assigned by the higher authorities of the Mission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka District Manager - Farm Livelihood Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the job page on the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal (link below). Create a free account if you do not have one. If you do, sign in. Choose "Sign In to Apply" for the District Manager - Farm Livelihood (Mandya) opening. Fill in the application and submit it before the portal closes on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Which district is this post for?
faq.answer: Mandya. The opening is listed for all talukas of the district.

faq.question: Q2. Can a B.Sc (Agriculture) graduate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. A B.Sc (Agriculture) or allied farm sector graduate needs at least 04 years of field level work experience in a relevant field.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience does an M.Sc. (Agriculture) holder need?
faq.answer: At least 02 years of field level work experience in a relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. Can someone with a Master's degree outside agriculture apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Any other Master degree is accepted with at least 07 years of field level work experience in farm livelihoods or a relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. Who will the District Manager coordinate with?
faq.answer: With Block and Cluster level Farm Livelihoods Managers / Coordinators, with other line departments for convergence at district level, and with the farm livelihoods CRPs.

faq.question: Q6. Does the job involve market linkage work?
faq.answer: Yes. The duties include identifying institutional and local buyers and conducting buyer-seller meets.

faq.question: Q7. Do I need an account to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. You must create a free account or sign in on the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal before you can submit an application.
